slides.title: The shame-free cleaning rules I live by now
Rules for an ADHD home
items: Any progress counts, even one dish
Rest is not a reward, it's a need
Start small, stop when you want

slides.title: Done beats perfect
slides.body: A half-cleared counter is better than a perfect plan in your head. Take the half.

slides.title: Progress counts
slides.body: One dish, one sock, one wipe. You moved the house forward today. That's a win.

slides.title: Stop when you want to
slides.body: Leaving the job half-done is okay. Stopping before burnout means you'll come back tomorrow.

slides.title: My home doesn't need to be perfect. It needs to work for the brain that lives here.
Put the rules on your wall
slides.body: The Tidy Brain Printable Pack includes printable rules, checklists and trackers for bad days and good ones. Link in bio.
